lessons.title: Thank the Chef
lessons.objective: Ask to thank the chef, connect the main course to a vivid memory of your grandmother, express deep gratitude, and say you will tell your children about this meal.
lessons.focus: Puis-je remercier le chef ? asks the server to bring the chef over. Le goût du plat principal me rappelle la table de ma grand-mère links the meal to a specific memory. J'ai presque pleuré describes the emotion. Je vais parler de ce repas à mes enfants uses aller + infinitive to promise that you will tell them about the meal; Je n'oublierai jamais ce goût uses the future for a lasting memory.
lessons.scene: In a small bistro in Paris's Marais, the guest finishes dinner and asks the server whether they can thank the chef. The chef comes out of the kitchen, and the guest stands up from the table to speak. The guest thanks the chef for the very special evening, says the flavor of the main course reminds them of a grandmother's table and that they almost cried, praises the wine, dessert, and service, and says they will tell their children about the meal. The chef smiles and thanks them for coming.
